verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe one-click agentic Finishing Touches that fix review findings on the PR, single-click application of suggested changes without leaving the PR, prompting CodeRabbit to generate its own improvements, and choosing how fixes land from Change Stack. A community thread independently confirms CodeRabbit offers directly committable fixes. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the agentic fix-findings flow itself (only the committable-suggestion path is independently confirmed), plus detailed docs on how agent-generated fixes land (direct commit vs. follow-up PR).
